title: The Space Ship
lines: Jane and Ben have a big box.
"Let us make a space ship," said Jane.
They tape on a nose and a face.
They hop in and race up to space.
Then Grace runs up. "Is there a place?"
The box is small. There is no space.
Grace sits on the steps with a sad face.
Ben sticks a small box on with tape.
"That is your place, Grace," said Jane.
Grace, Jane and Ben race off to space.

questions.ask: What do Jane and Ben use to make the ship?
questions.listenFor: A big box and tape. Lines one to three say it.

questions.ask: What was the problem when Grace ran up?
questions.listenFor: The box was small, so there was no space for her. Line six says it. This is the middle of the story.

questions.ask: Grace has a sad face in this story. Which line tells you why?
questions.listenFor: Line six and line seven — the box was small, so there was no space for her.
